    <title>v1.67.0/v0.161.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Images and binaries here: <a href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/tag/v0.161.0">https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/tag/v0.161.0</a></h3>
<h2>End User Changelog</h2>
<h3>🛑 Breaking changes 🛑</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>pkg/pprofile</code>: Remove deprecated AggregationTemporality, Duration, SetDuration (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5281506997" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15855" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15855/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15855">#15855</a>)</li>
<li><code>pkg/scraperhelper/controller</code>: Remove deprecated AddScraper func (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5425568436" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15934" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15934/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15934">#15934</a>)</li>
<li><code>pkg/service</code>: Remove deprecated ZapOptions (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5426103169" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15935" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15935/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15935">#15935</a>)</li>
<li><code>pkg/xconfmap</code>: Remove deprecated WithForceUnmarshaler func (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5425464213" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15932" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15932/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15932">#15932</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>💡 Enhancements 💡</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>pkg/pdata</code>: avoid allocations in WriteInt64 and WriteUint64 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4939108413" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15629" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15629/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15629">#15629</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>🧰 Bug fixes 🧰</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>cmd/schemagen</code>: Accept components written without a configuration body in the generated Collector configuration schema (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5069942307" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15728" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15728/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15728">#15728</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/confmap</code>: Fix bug where an escaped URI appearing before a valid URI prevented the subsequent URI from being expanded. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5304365303" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15867" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15867/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15867">#15867</a>)<br>
URI scanning now continues after an escaped URI while preserving the escaped expression as literal text.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/featuregate</code>: Reject feature gate IDs with an empty dot-separated segment (leading, trailing, or consecutive dots), e.g. <code>.foo</code>, <code>foo.</code>, <code>foo..bar</code>. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4999340227" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15676" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15676/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15676">#15676</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/pprofile</code>: Stop erasing inline attribute keys when key_strindex is unset, and clear key_strindex once it is resolved. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5202904568" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15793" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15793/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15793">#15793</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/pprofile</code>: Reference resource and scope attribute strings via the ProfilesDictionary string table when marshaling and unmarshaling OTLP profiles export requests. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5202767242" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15792" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15792/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15792">#15792</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/scraperhelper</code>: Fix shutdown being delayed by extra scrapes when a scrape runs longer than the collection interval (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5074280446" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15736" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15736/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15736">#15736</a>)<br>
If a scrape was still running when the next tick fired, the pending tick and the shutdown<br>
signal could both be ready when it finished and the controller chose between them at random.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<h2>API Changelog</h2>
<h3>🛑 Breaking changes 🛑</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>cmd/mdatagen</code>: remove deprecated func DefaultMetricsBuilderConfig (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5281445953" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15854" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15854/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15854">#15854</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/service</code>: Remove the deprecated <code>extensioncapabilities.ConfigWatcher</code> interface, <code>Extensions.NotifyConfig</code>, and <code>service.Settings.CollectorConf</code>. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4600178432" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15399" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15399/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15399">#15399</a>)<br>
These were deprecated in v0.155.0. Use <code>ConfigSnapshotWatcher</code>, <code>NotifyConfigSnapshot</code>, and<br>
<code>Settings.ConfigSnapshot</code> instead.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>pkg/service</code>: Remove deprecated config option LoggingOptions (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5415758982" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15919" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15919/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15919">#15919</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>💡 Enhancements 💡</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>pkg/config/confignet</code>: Migrate network core types to schema-based configuration generated by mdatagen. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5050795763" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15706" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15706/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/pull/15706">#15706</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>🧰 Bug fixes 🧰</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>pkg/configoptional</code>: Properly marshal and unmarshal <code>encoding.TextMarshaler</code>/<code>encoding.TextUnmarshaler</code> types (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4949614825" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15636" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15636/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15636">#15636</a>)</li>
<li><code>pkg/featuregate</code>: Reject feature gate IDs with an empty dot-separated segment (leading, trailing, or consecutive dots), e.g. <code>.foo</code>, <code>foo.</code>, <code>foo..bar</code>. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4999340227" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15676" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15676/hovercard" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/15676">#15676</a>)</li>
</ul>
</content>
